Chapter 1223 - 33: The Fate Of Shadow Demon And Nine Phoenix (Request For Subscription)

Chapter 1223: Chapter 33: The Fate of Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix (Request for Subscription)

Given Lin Yuan’s profound foundation, crossing from the Dominator Realm to the Chaos Realm presents no difficulty whatsoever.

The reason for waiting until now is merely to allow himself to grow to the limit in all aspects, thus gaining more when crossing into the Chaos Realm.

"Break through directly."

Lin Yuan did not hesitate, and at the moment he reached the peak of perfection, he began the leap and enhancement of his life’s essence.

Boom!

Lin Yuan’s mind and will began to roar, as if breaking through some bottleneck shackle—

His physical body began to improve frantically.

His soul’s will also began to surge rapidly.

The universe within his body likewise began to evolve swiftly.

...

Everything was being enhanced by a wide margin.

Before this, Lin Yuan’s several breakthroughs, such as mastering the Third Layer of "Infinite Void" and evolving the path of Chaos Power, only enhanced him in certain aspects or focused on a particular facet.

But now?

Lin Yuan was experiencing an all-encompassing enhancement.

This enhancement was not just from Dominator Realm to Chaos Realm, but directly from Dominator Realm to the pinnacle of Chaos Realm.

Lin Yuan had already evolved the path of Chaos Power; crossing into the Chaos Realm directly reached the pinnacle level, without any need for further refinement or cultivation.

...

Swoosh.

The universe within his body was boundless.

When Lin Yuan chose to break through to the Chaos Realm, the universe within him once again expanded, with the principles of time and space becoming increasingly perfect, approaching the Chaos Void.

The jade gourd trembled, and a red-clad girl stood nearby, observing the changes in the universe within his body from afar.

"Finally crossed into the Chaos Realm."

The red-clad girl let out a deep sigh of relief.

If Lin Yuan did not cross into the Chaos Realm soon, she might have started to doubt her understanding.

Which Dominator Realm powerhouse can bore such a large piece of eternal adamantite and possess the combat power of an Invincible Great Saint directly?

The red-clad girl could be said to have watched Lin Yuan grow from the early stages of the Twelfth Layer to his current level, being quite clear about his growth speed and combat power at each level of his realm.

"Does a Dominator Realm already possess Invincible Great Saint combat power, how strong will it be upon reaching the Chaos Realm?"

Even the knowledgeable red-clad girl couldn’t help but look forward to it. In the Chaos Void, Invincible Great Saints, although rarely matched against each other, indeed belong to different levels of strength.

The red-clad girl was unclear about other Invincible Great Saints, but as for the inheritor of "Infinite Void"... normally, mastering the Fifth Layer of "Infinite Void" equates to possessing Invincible Great Saint combat power.

And mastering the Sixth Layer of "Infinite Void" is still an Invincible Great Saint, but certainly much stronger than those at the Fifth Layer.

"If nothing unexpected happens, this should be the strongest Invincible Great Saint of the ’Infinite Void’ lineage, right?"

The red-clad girl thought silently, feeling that Lin Yuan’s internal universe had already reached a level comparable to the Sixth Layer of "Infinite Void."

While Lin Yuan’s cultivation in "Infinite Void" remains at the Third Layer, there are still the Fourth and Fifth Layers ahead.

There is indeed plenty of room for improvement.

"Those not fully formed special places?"

The red-clad girl gazed at certain special location nodes in the internal universe, which were precisely Lin Yuan’s evolutions from the fundamental elements of special places, creating smaller special places.

At this moment, as the internal universe grew, these smaller special places were also swiftly transforming.

"The time beings stand high above, they specifically opened these special places, and occasionally cast their gaze down, not out of boredom..."

The red-clad girl thought silently.

From the height of time beings, they wouldn’t care about matters below the Thirteenth Layer, even the legacies they created wouldn’t be overemphasized, but many special places, however, are particularly ’cared for.’

The red-clad girl was certain that if any special place faced complete destruction, it would almost certainly draw the attention of the time being behind it, possibly even their direct arrival.

...

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, this breakthrough was vastly more calm compared to the earlier pathbreaking entry into the Dominator Realm, causing hardly any spectacular energy fluctuations.

The transformation of his life’s essence, and all forms of enhancement, were completed in silence.

"Is this the Chaos Realm?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, observing the Chaos Void within his field of vision once more changed, comprehending the essence of time and space, and the essence of the operation of the grand path, all understood fully.

The elevation of the essence of life rendered Lin Yuan’s vision anew, as if ascending from a small hill to a ten-thousand-meter peak, overlooking all mountains below.

"Chaos Void..."

Lin Yuan gazed upon the world nurturing innumerable lives, even to peerless Great Saints, the Chaos Void is vast and boundless, so immense it’s unimaginable, impossible to traverse entirely in a lifetime.

Yet at this moment, Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that the Chaos Void has boundaries, though the specific boundaries were not yet clear, they certainly exist.

"So vast."

It was the first time Lin Yuan so clearly felt the Chaos Void.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze fell on some nodes of the Chaos Void that vaguely contained another world.

"Those nodes must be the special places..."

Lin Yuan’s expression was thoughtful, "The Thirteenth Layer beings specifically opened these special places, occasionally casting their gaze down, because these special places compensate for the hidden flaws of the Chaos Void..."

At Lin Yuan’s current realm, though still far from being comparable to the Thirteenth Layer time beings, he could discern many essences, and vaguely understand some uses of those special places.

Even as vast as the Chaos Void, it is not truly perfect and still contains some flaws.
